subject: [PATCH 02/16] selftests/mm: add folio-order check for VA ranges

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function called `is_range_backed_by_folio_orders` to the Linux kernel's selftest suite. The function checks whether a given virtual address (VA) range is backed by folios of exactly a specified order, mapped head-to-tail and naturally aligned. It does this by checking that each order-aligned window of the VA range maps one such folio, and that the first PFN in each window is the naturally aligned folio head. This check is necessary for memory huge page (mTHP) collapse tests to ensure that the range collapses into order-@order folios.
